description: Forcing yourself to stop scrolling is not a solution, but there are ways to deal with pain and that’s what I am talking about on my page
transcript: Two questions to tell you exactly why you're scrolling right now. You're not doing it because you're tired. You're doing it to get distracted. Now, ask yourself another question. Despite that pain, why are you still going to do that? Why it is so important that you're still going to do that even you know why it hurts? Now, focus on that one. Follow me. Close your Instagram and see you tomorrow.
